caption: Performance comparisons of four various prompts of HDM in humour, fluency and coherency, marked by V1, V2, V3 and V4. The y-axis is the score on the GEMBA-SQM.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the performance comparisons of four prompts—labeled V1, V2, V3, and V4—across a metric referred to as “Coherency,” which is measured using the GEMBA-SQM scale. The horizontal axis represents the four prompt categories: V1, V2, V3, and V4, listed in sequential order. The vertical axis represents the coherency score, using a linear scale ranging from 86 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 2, and no units are specified. Four individual bars are displayed, each corresponding to a prompt. The V1 prompt is represented by a blue bar with a height of approximately 93.69. The V2 prompt is shown as an orange bar reaching a height of approximately 93.8. The V3 prompt is portrayed as a green bar, with a height of approximately 94.5, and the V4 prompt is depicted as a purple bar with a height of 91.1. The bars are not sorted and there is no visual emphasis applied to any particular bar.
